title: Kestrel GAP Waiver: Coverage of the Loan Balance by Level
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver — Coverage of the Loan Balance by Level

Not every part of a loan balance is covered by a Kestrel GAP Waiver. Three parts of the balance — negative equity from a trade-in rolled into the loan, financed back-end products, and deferred installments — are covered at some levels and not at others; a fixed list of amounts is deducted from the payoff at every level.

## Coverage table

| Part of the loan balance | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rolled-in trade-in negative equity covered | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Balance from financed service contracts and maintenance plans covered | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Deferred installments whose balance is still covered | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Installments moved past the original maturity by a deferral stay covered | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Insurer deductions for unrepaired prior damage covered | No | No | No | No | No | No |

Deferred installments above the number shown for a level are excluded. Financed back-end products means KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts and KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans included in the amount financed.

## Amounts deducted from the payoff at every level

For all six levels — Kestrel GAP Essential, Standard, Plus, Premier, Premier Plus and Max — the benefit exclusions, deducted from the payoff before the benefit is computed, are:

1. past-due installments;
2. late and returned-payment fees;
3. deferred installments;
4. refunds of cancelled add-on products;
5. insurer deductions for prior damage;
6. salvage retained by the owner.

## Questions on the table

**Is the negative equity from a rolled-in trade-in part of the covered balance on a Kestrel GAP Standard waiver?**
No. Rolled-in negative equity is covered on Plus, Premier, Premier Plus and Max only.

**On which levels does the balance from a financed service contract or maintenance plan stay covered?**
Premier, Premier Plus and Max. On Essential, Standard and Plus it is not covered.

**A Kestrel GAP Premier waiver's loan has had three installments deferred. How many of them keep their balance covered?**
Two; the third is above the covered number for Premier and is excluded. (Hypothetical count.)

**A deferral has pushed installments past the original maturity date. Are they covered on Kestrel GAP Plus?**
No. Installments moved past the original maturity by a deferral stay covered on Premier, Premier Plus and Max only.
